title: Chapter 326: Prestige Spreads Far And Wide
content:
Chapter 326: Prestige Spreads Far And Wide

During this time, a piece of news suddenly appeared in the entire Yamamoto County, quickly swept through all the villages and towns in the county, and spread to the surrounding villages and counties.

In Yamamoto County, a noble samurai came from nowhere. In just one month, he frequently appeared in the mountains of Yamamoto County, searching for monsters in dangerous places, and beheaded them.

However, in January, more than 60 monsters that were raging in the entire Yamamoto County were beheaded by one hand.

And the name of the beheaded Zhong Yu spread throughout the entire Yamamoto County, and was deeply admired and grateful by all the people in the county.

After the surrounding counties heard about it, many villagers sent envoys to invite Zhong Yu to their villages to help them slay demons and demons for the benefit of one side.

Although the name of the person who slays demons is a bit strange, there are only two characters, which is far from the mainstream name in Japan.

But so what, as long as he has strong strength, everything can be ignored.

What's more, who can rule out that there are only two names, not for the purpose of hiding one's name and avoiding the search of the family.

Therefore, everyone in the entire Yamamoto County regards Zhong Yu as a descendant of a big family. Mastering a high level of cultivation and an outstanding temperament, like a nobleman who has been passed down for thousands of years.

For Zhong Yu, he was in awe and admiration.

Be in awe of his mighty strength and admire his noble blood. Countless families in the counties want to invite him to their family as a guest, so as to increase the glory of their family.

However, whether it was the request of the villagers in other counties or the invitation of the rich family in Yamamoto County, Zhong Yu rejected them all.

He has one more important thing to do now.

On a high mountain in Yamamoto County, this is the highest mountain in Yamamoto County, with a full length of thousands of meters. The top of the peak is inserted into the clouds, surrounded by clouds and mist, like a fairyland.

However, such a beautiful place has never been dared to step into it before.

Because there used to be a demon with a strength as high as the third rank, and the strength of this demon belonged to the top group in the entire Sanben County.

Except for the patriarchs of a few powerful families who possess the strength of Tier 3, the patriarchs of other weak families are only Tier 2 masters, far inferior to this monster.

So out of fear, this high mountain was occupied by a demon alone. After a long time, because this demon was cruel by nature, it kept devouring the passers-by, and finally made this high mountain gradually depopulated and turned into a wasteland.

However, this demon was eventually defeated.

Just ten days ago, after clearing all the monsters in the entire Yamamoto army, Zhong Yu came to his last target, which was the third-tier monster on the mountain.

This monster is the most powerful in the entire Yamamoto army, and it is also the banner of all monsters, supporting the belief of all monsters.

As long as he is beheaded, Zhong Yu's reputation will be deeply rooted in the hearts of the people, and the name of martial bravery will be chanted by everyone, and people will be deeply feared and admired.

Then, Zhong Yu went up the mountain.

Not long after, under the expectant eyes of everyone, Zhong Yu came down the mountain.

The strength of this monster is only at the third level, but after Zhong Yu has been fighting the monster for so long, his strength has already recovered a lot, and he has also reached the third level.

During the first crusade against the boy who swallowed wine, Zhong Yu discovered a weakness of these monsters.

That's what these monsters are. Although they are endowed with extraordinary talents and possess great strength, they cannot effectively use them. Using their own strength is like a child's dancing stick, rough and can't really display their own strength.

This is the weakness left by these demons without systematic inheritance, and it is also an important reason why human beings can drive out demons and become the masters of this world.

In addition to the extremely fast growth of human beings themselves, it takes 100 years for demons to cultivate their strength. Humans may achieve it in a few years or ten years.

Also, the reproductive ability of human beings is terrifying, and it is many times better than that of monsters. In addition to the difference in the number of people, even if the monsters are powerful, they will gradually be overwhelmed by the sea of people.

Of course, in addition to the above two points, there are the most important.

That is the monster, and there is no systematic inheritance. Their respective strengths are only slowly exploring their own abilities, and then using them.

This kind of groping is extremely rough, and it can only benefit him alone. After all, there are contradictions among monsters.

In this way, the difference in personal combat power between them and those humans who have systematic inheritance and countless exquisite secrets is even greater.

Therefore, when Zhong Yu eliminated the Jiu-Tuning Boy, he directly used the wonderful lightness kung fu obtained in the Mingyue World of Qin Dynasty, quickly crossed countless distances, and chopped off the head of the Jiu-Tuning Boy with a single knife, winning the battle The battle is won.

And Zhong Yu, relying on the inheritance of all kinds of magical techniques obtained in Qin Shimingyue, quickly killed monsters with extremely poor skills, and spread his reputation throughout the entire Yamamoto County.

And Zhong Yu's various magical methods are also an important reason why all the tyrants in Sanben County think that he has an extraordinary background.

Only those who were born in a strong family like theirs can understand the preciousness of these magical methods.

That is a family, and after countless years of exploration, all kinds of wonderful methods have been summed up, each of which is extremely precious and cannot be easily shown to others.

Even if they are members of the same bloodline, their family will not easily bestow these magical methods unless they have made great contributions.

It is terrifying to see that the subtlety of Zhong Yu's wonderful method is far better than what their family has come up with after hundreds of years of exploration.

With this level of sophistication, no matter how you say it, it takes hundreds of years of groping and a profound heritage to obtain it.

There is a person with such a heritage, you say that he was born in a poor family and is a pariah, who would believe it.

What's more, from Zhong Yu's demeanor and behavior, there is nothing that does not reveal a high-ranking temperament, although his etiquette is different from the Japanese mainstream and seems to be unique.

But it is undeniable that these etiquettes have a profound cultural heritage, and every move seems to be in harmony with the way of heaven, which makes people feel admirable.

Therefore, the etiquette that is different from the mainstream is also considered by them to be an ancient etiquette inherited from ancient times and gradually forgotten by the world, which makes them feel even more admirable.

After Zhong Yu beheaded the third-tier monster, he lived under the high mountain.

And using the wealth plundered from killing demons, he recruited thousands of workers and asked them to build a hall on the top of the mountain as his dojo.

For Zhong Yu's idea of inheriting his wonderful method, the powerful people in the entire Yamamoto County did not reject, but even more supported.
